assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game UI button sprite for LORE, the Biblion magic library card game. Generate ONE finished square button, front-on orthographic, centered, occupying 88% of the canvas, on genuinely transparent background. Icon: an open ledger with three short engraved record lines, recognizable duel log
